info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Estimates-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Estimates API provides businesses with the ability to access detailed estimates for insurance claims. This endpoint allows users to retrieve various estimates associated with specified claims, aiding in comprehensive claim assessment and management. Typical consumers include insurance adjusters, claim processors, and analysts who require accurate information to facilitate quicker decision-making. This API streamlines the claim evaluation process by offering timely access to vital estimates, enhancing the overall efficiency of insurance operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve an estimate for a specific claim, providing important financial information needed for processing and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve an estimate for claims by providing the necessary parameters in JSON format. Ensure that all required fields are accurately filled to receive a valid estimate response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the estimate data.
